name: wing-rack-mcp
description: Controls the Behringer WING Rack over OSC on the LAN. No credentials: the desk is unauthenticated UDP, so nothing is read from Credential Manager and no secret exists to store. The command profile is generated off the hardware; 15 destructive or action addresses are excluded from the writable set and unreachable from any tool. String values carrying a space or comma are written to their own leaf address and read back to confirm, because the node key=value form silently strips spaces and splits on commas. wing_push_file pushes a complete show file as a background job Claude can trigger and poll (wing_push_status), retrying the whole push up to three times on failure; it replaces wing_push_show, retired in this version. v0.3.1: a show file that omits keys on a node writes the keys it gives and reports the omitted ones as partial; only a model-only node (mdl and nothing else) is withheld.

tools.name: verify_connection
tools.description: Health check. Returns SERVER_VERSION, the loaded profile's firmware and node count, and which desk is connected.

tools.name: wing_list_consoles
tools.description: Every WING answering on the network: console name, address, model, serial, firmware.

tools.name: wing_connect
tools.description: Connect to a desk by console name. Never by address.

tools.name: wing_get
tools.description: Read one or more nodes: current values, read-only flags, legal ranges and child nodes.

tools.name: wing_set
tools.description: Write named parameters to one node in a single OSC message. Whole-message validation; nothing is sent if any key fails.

tools.name: wing_dump
tools.description: Read a subtree to a show file, walking child by child around the desk's reply buffer limit.

tools.name: wing_push_file
tools.description: Push a complete show file as a background job and return a job id immediately. No confirm token. Retries the whole push up to three times on failure; one push at a time, never queued.

tools.name: wing_push_status
tools.description: Poll a background push: state, nodes done against total, elapsed seconds, a running failure count, and the report file's path.

tools.name: wing_generate_profile
tools.description: Re-walk the desk and rebuild the command profile. Run after a firmware change.
